sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Hová*? asks where someone is going. Use a destination form with movement verbs such as *megy* and jön.

items.english: Károly is going to the shop.

sections.content: megy and jön are a matched pair worth learning together: megy is ‘goes’ (away from the speaker), jön is ‘comes’ (toward the speaker) — the same distinction English makes, just packed into two short, unrelated-looking verbs. Neither shares a root with the other, so there’s no shortcut; they simply have to be memorized as a duo.
